documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Sportking India Limited reported a strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by healthy demand in domestic and export markets, improved realizations, and stable raw material costs. Management highlighted the near-completion of their 150,000 spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha, which is expected to commence commercial production within the next 30 to 40 days and contribute to revenue in the current financial year. The company remains optimistic about medium to long-term industry tailwinds, including supportive global sourcing trends, favorable trade agreements, and cost efficiencies from solar power and state-level subsidies. Furthermore, management expects current margin levels and yarn-cotton spreads to remain sustainable over the next several months, supported by strong order visibility until March. Sportking India presented its financial and operational performance for Q2 & H1 FY27, reporting best-in-class capacity utilization levels of over 96%.

guidance.claim: The company expects a revenue contribution of INR150 crores to INR200 crores from the new Odisha capacity in the remaining period of the current financial year.
guidance.quote: So we expect a contribution of around INR150 crores to INR200 crores coming off the capacity in the time left in this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates achieving revenue of INR1,200 crores to INR1,300 crores from the Odisha project in the next financial year.
guidance.quote: And we expect a revenue of around INR1,200 to INR1,300 crores in next financial year and about INR150 to INR200 crores in this financial year.

guidance.claim: Margins in the new Odisha unit are expected to be at least 4% to 5% or maybe 6% higher than the existing operations once fully operational.
guidance.quote: So, our margins in Odisha unit will be at least 4% to 5%, or maybe 6% more than whatever we achieve once it is operational.

guidance.claim: For the upcoming quarters, the depreciation run rate is expected to be around INR17 crores.
guidance.quote: So from next quarter, we expect the run rate to be around INR17 crores – vis-à-vis INR24 in last quarter and INR14 in this quarter.

guidance.claim: The proposed capex program is estimated to require 12 to 15 months for completion.
guidance.quote: # Proposed capex programme to tak 12-15 months to complete

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue to reach around INR3,000 crores for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: So this year, last year, our top line was around INR2,500 crores. So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue to exceed INR4,000 crores next year with the new plant.
guidance.quote: And next year, with the new plant, we see this going up to around more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Long-term EBITDA margins are expected to stay around 15% after the Odisha plant is operational.
guidance.quote: Frankly, if you ask me, 28%, there was a lot of issues of supply chain disruptions and there were many duplication of orders. So that year was an aberration. But otherwise, we expect the long-term margins to stay after our Odisha plant around 15%.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from export markets continued to be healthy, supported by improving business conditions across the global textile value chain.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from our export markets continued to be healthy, supported by improving business conditions across the global textile value chain.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports accounted for approximately 52% of the company's total revenue in the last quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: So it is about 52% of our total revenue the last quarter has been through exports.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from China and Bangladesh continues to be robust.
demand_outlook.quote: So the demand from China and Bangladesh continue to be robust and the Indian market was a little bit slow in last 2 months, 3 months, but with this festival season approaching and the spring production commencing after Diwali, which is traditionally the peak season for the domestic market.

demand_outlook.claim: The company holds visibility for its order book until March 10, with demand remaining the same or even better.
demand_outlook.quote: So right now we have a visibility for the next till 10 March and it is pretty good. The demand is the same or even better than what it was.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from all markets continued to remain healthy, with supportive domestic demand expected from the festive season and improving consumption trends.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from all the markets continued to remain healthy, and we are also encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter. On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: Global cotton yarn demand has improved, supported by supply chain realignment and increased sourcing diversification by international customers.
demand_outlook.quote: Another encouraging trend has been the improvement in global cotton yarn demand. Supply chain realignment, healthy export demand and increased sourcing diversification by international customers, which has supported the yarn realizations and profitability.

demand_outlook.claim: Incremental demand for Indian yarn exports is predominantly driven by China as its domestic market has become more active.
demand_outlook.quote: China has been the tipping point for what has happened in the last 8, 9 months. Chinese market was very subdued for last 4, 5 years. And we have seen an increased demand. So most of the incremental demand, which has come into India for yarn export is from China.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000 spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing on schedule with building construction almost complete and machinery arriving in a staggered manner.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front are 150,000 spindle Greenfield expansion project in Odisha continues to progress on schedule. Having secured all necessary regulatory approvals, the building construction is now almost complete. The entire machinery package has been ordered and has started arriving on the site in a staggered manner.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production for the Odisha project is expected to start within the next 30 to 40 days.
capex_expansion.quote: Like, our Greenfield project to come in 8 months is a big achievement for us and we intend to start commercial production within next 30 days, 40 days.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved acquiring a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited and manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis, subject to the completion and execution of definitive agreements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a 40.3 MW solar power plant to supply electricity to its Bathinda and Ludhiana units.
capex_expansion.quote: The SPV has commissioned the Solar Power Plant with capacity of 40.3 MW for supply of power to Company`s Bathinda and Ludhiana Unit for period of 25 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front, I'm pleased to share that our solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing as planned, with construction underway.
capex_expansion.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned. We are very excited with that. Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin improved significantly to 19.8% in Q2 FY27 compared to 10.4% in Q2 FY26, driven by improved demand, operational efficiency, and stable cotton prices.
margins_costs.quote: So the key factors are of course vis-à-vis last year is the improved demand. The demand for cotton and blended yarn has been going up for last two to three quarters. And another thing which has contributed to this is our operational efficiency, which has caused the work we have been doing on our costs has been paying dividends now. And all the efforts we put in last 2 years, 3 years in being more cost efficient is now there to see. And thirdly, stable cotton prices, which has been there for last 1 year and continue to be so has also helped.

margins_costs.claim: The newly commissioned solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Beyond supporting our environmental goals, the project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%. Thereby enhancing our overall cost competitiveness.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects the margins achieved in the first half of the year to be sustainable for the second half.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, I definitely think that what margins we have made in the first half are sustainable and I'm talking about our old capacity. So whatever we are doing with our old capacity, we expect to be there or thereabouts in the second half also.

margins_costs.claim: Yarn spreads in Q2 FY27 were around INR141 per kg.
margins_costs.quote: No, Q1 was around INR133 and Q2 has been around INR141.

margins_costs.claim: The commissioned solar power plant operations are expected to yield power cost savings of around 12-15% in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: Earnings growth was driven by better yarn realizations, strong export demand, and disciplined raw material procurement.
margins_costs.quote: The quarter was particularly encouraging as the growth in earnings was driven by a combination of better yarn realizations, strong export demand and disciplined raw material procurement.

margins_costs.claim: Strategic buying enabled the company to manage input costs and protect margins despite raw material price increases.
margins_costs.quote: Despite some increases in raw material prices during this period, our strategic buying approach enabled us to effectively manage input costs and protect margins.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: The project is expected to reduce our annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%, while simultaneously increasing the share of renewable energy in our overall power consumption.

margins_costs.claim: The Odisha plant is embedded with incentives, and its margins are expected to be at least 300 to 400 basis points higher than older plants.
margins_costs.quote: So about EBITDA accretion, this plant has many incentives which are embedded. So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

margins_costs.claim: The annual cost savings from the solar project are expected to be around INR15 crores.
margins_costs.quote: It should be around INR15 crores with this solar park, yes.

margins_costs.claim: The overall product spread for the quarter was INR133 compared to INR107 in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So the overall spread was INR133 vis-a-vis INR107 last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing manufacturing facilities operated at nearly full capacity (99%) during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: as the company is already cranking up at 99% capacity this quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Bangladesh demand for the company has been consistent at about 45,000 to 50,000 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: And the demand there has been even in these difficult times which they have had because the energy crisis has been pretty consistent at about 45,000 to 50,000 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: China has been buying cotton yarn at about 60,000 tons over the last 12 months.
orders_capacity.quote: And China also, for last 12 months, they have been buying at about 60,000 because their cotton prices are much higher, the local prices are much higher than ours.

orders_capacity.claim: Spinning Unit I has an installed capacity of 66,480 spindles.
orders_capacity.quote: Unit I - Spinning Unit Acrylic/Blended Acrylic Polyester Yarn/ Blended Polyester Cotton yarn 66,480 Spindles

orders_capacity.claim: Spinning Unit III operates with an installed capacity of 3,12,672 spindles.
orders_capacity.quote: Unit III - Spinning Unit Compact/contamination free cotton / Polyester cotton blended yarn 3,12,672 Spindles

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days as part of its risk management policy.
orders_capacity.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory. And we continue to do that. We still have the similar kind of order book as we had end of the last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: In the Odisha project, the company is entitled to a 30% capital subsidy to be paid in 5 equal installments, translating to about INR200 crores to INR220 crores on a INR1,000 crores investment.
capital_allocation.quote: First is the capital subsidy, which we are going to get for 30% capital subsidy, which will be paid to us in 5 equal installments. On a INR1,000 crores investment, we are looking at about INR200 to INR220 crores coming back to us in 5 years.

capital_allocation.claim: The company secured a power tariff of INR4 per unit for 10 years in Odisha, compared to a blended cost of around INR6 in Punjab.
capital_allocation.quote: And then we have a power subsidy which is from a blended cost of around 6 in Punjab right now. We are going to get power at INR4 for 10 years in Odisha.

capital_allocation.claim: Under the Odisha employment guarantee scheme, the company receives around INR7,000 to INR8,000 per laborer per month for 5 years.
capital_allocation.quote: And then there is an employment guarantee scheme which gives us around INR7,000 to INR8,000 per labor per month to us for 5 years.

capital_allocation.claim: By March 2027, the peak long-term debt is expected to be around INR700 crores to INR750 crores, with working capital not exceeding INR200 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, by March '27, we expect our peak debt to be -- the long-term debt to be, you can say, around INR750 crores, maybe less, about INR700 crores. And working capital, we don't expect to be spending more than INR200 crores. So, below $1,000 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that trade receivables increased from INR396.2 crores in March 2026 to INR473.5 crores in September due to higher overall billing and sales.
risks_headwinds.quote: So this is I think maybe -- I think if you see the number of days, there won't be much difference. I think it's just because our total turnover has gone up and most of our kind of sales are at 120 days credit covered by LC, 120 days LC. So this is because of that.

risks_headwinds.claim: Business risks outlined by the company include macroeconomic trends in domestic and global markets, industry performance, competition, and operational execution.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company's future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cashflows, the Company's market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global cotton prices have experienced turbulence in recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: While global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months, we remain focused on prudent procurement and efficient inventory management.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to start commercial production at the Odisha greenfield project within the next 30 to 40 days.
management_commitments.quote: Like, our Greenfield project to come in 8 months is a big achievement for us and we intend to start commercial production within next 30 days, 40 days.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to merge the fabric and garment companies into the main entity within the next couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So I think within next couple of months we intend to -- I think this will happen.

management_commitments.claim: The proposed capex expansion program is projected to take 12 to 15 months to complete.
management_commitments.quote: # Proposed capex programme to tak 12-15 months to complete

management_commitments.claim: The solar power project is expected to deliver 12-15% power cost savings over the long term.
management_commitments.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

management_commitments.claim: The first phase of production for the Odisha greenfield expansion is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We are very excited with that. Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The entire Odisha expansion project is intended to be finished within the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The plant capacity utilization for the Odisha project is expected to reach about 90% by the end of March.
management_commitments.quote: And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
